data.name: Budu
data.gender_notes: Budu is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The name Budu is derived from the Sanskrit word 'budhah', meaning wise or intelligent. It is also associated with the Buddha, representing the enlightened one. In Hindu mythology, Budu is a name for the deity Ganesha, the elephant-headed god who is the remover of obstacles. The name Budu carries the meaning “Blessed, Fortunate” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Budu usually hope their child will grow to embody blessed, fortunate and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.etymology: Budu belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Blessed, Fortunate.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Budu total 3, giving a life-path number of 3. Number 3 is linked with Jupiter and with the qualities of creativity, expression and optimism.

data.cultural_impact: The name Budu has a significant impact on Indian culture, particularly among communities in South India. It is a common name for both boys and girls and is often used as a term of respect or endearment for elders. In some regions, it is also used as a nickname or surname. This shows the importance of wisdom and intelligence in Indian society, as embodied in the name Budu.
data.spiritual_significance: In Hinduism, the name Budu holds great spiritual significance as it represents the attainment of wisdom and enlightenment. It is a reminder of the importance of seeking knowledge and understanding, both in this life and in the spiritual realm. Moreover, the association of Budu with Ganesha underscores the idea of overcoming obstacles and achieving success through intelligence and perseverance. Thus, the name Budu is not only a source of inspiration but also a reminder of the spiritual journey towards self-realization.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Budu is a name derived from the Sanskrit term 'Budha', which signifies wisdom or intelligence. It is believed that individuals named Budu are blessed with keen insight and a deep understanding of the world around them. This name is a reminder to continuously seek knowledge and wisdom in life.

historical_references.reference: Budu was a leader of the Vijayanagara Empire during the late 16th century. He played a significant role in the defense of the empire against invasions by the Deccan sultanate.
historical_references.context: Vijayanagara Empire defense against Deccan sultanate invasions

historical_references.reference: Budu was a prominent Shaivite saint and philosopher who lived in the 13th century. He is known for his contributions to the development of the Virashaiva sect of Hinduism.
